workbench: Activation 1.2.0 · 2,792 exact checks; 28/28 held cases both exact and operator-assisted; matched native constructors blocked before execution
authority: Public evidence, local computation, standard public GitHub reviews and release. No paid model calls, external operating commitments, protected approvals, or private member data.

construction.objective: Identify whether bounded exact arithmetic artifacts remove the observed output-admission bottleneck for transit timing, then measure same-model correctness.
construction.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via included CPU llama.cpp b12242; also attempt an actual operator-assisted included Codex artifact via the reviewed file handoff.
conditions: existing HARNESS process framing with positional evidence
named typed evidence with direct framing
construction.common: Same model and configuration, same quantities and four development cases, one request per condition with the same bound appropriate to compact four-expression output. Finish and refusal states are observed. Compare the exact incumbent for practical relevance. The known native format had different resource and content conditions and supplies engineering context only.
construction.independent: Freeze constructor examples and complete candidates before opening newly assembled confirmation for these arms; numerical reference computes expectations independently.
construction.decision: Complete admissible artifacts reaching the evaluator establish scoped admission. To claim amplification, require at least two more correctly accepted confirmation cases than both direct and existing HARNESS and no additional unsupported passes. Reveal negative and partial results.

covariance.objective: Test whether fitted covariance and a calibrated refinement reduce timing reservation at comparable coverage on later underlying transit observations.
sources: ExoClock III doi:10.3847/1538-4365/ac9da4; original data DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/P298N
ExoClock IV doi:10.3847/1538-4365/ae3238; original data DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/WPJTN
covariance.as_of: 2023-04-01 UTC is a calendar release cutoff; 2460035.5 is the corresponding numeric day fence for BJD TDB comparison, deliberately conservative by a day for observations. Require dated prior archive version evidence. Do not read training values from the later release. Report historical temporal validation; new prospective observations are a separate test.
covariance.cohort: The first eligible space timing for each planet strictly more than one day after the day fence in the later original release. Use only targets with an earlier published epoch, at least four distinct earlier epochs, reproducibly matched epoch, and positive stated times and uncertainties. Exclude the five development targets of Activation 1.2. Assign targets to calibration and confirmation by a fixed hash split. Do not filter on residuals or replace thin targets.
covariance.controls: Released fitted center with reported marginal uncertainties and an explicit covariance assumption; conventional full-covariance weighted fit; conventional robust Huber full-covariance fit. Calibrate intervals for all fitted models with the same held calibration targets. Independently check the weighted covariance by its normal equations.
covariance.candidate: Test horizon-stratified conformal-style scaling of weighted full-covariance forecasts against pooled scales; fit strata without using confirmation (relative target-specific extrapolation length). If strata are too small, fall back and record no distinctive intervention.
covariance.primary: Among eligible methods require at least 30 disjoint confirmation targets, observed coverage at least 90%, Wilson 95% lower bound at least 80%, and at least a 10% timing-window reduction against the narrowest qualifying conventional full-covariance method. Always report all full widths, paired errors, coverage, exclusions and minutes of hypothetical fixed-base observing windows. Operational adoption remains ABSTAIN.
covariance.stopping: One frozen historical cohort and model specification. No iteration on confirmation. A missing source vintage or inadequate evidence yields abstention; do not treat observation dates alone as availability.

transfer.objective: Check whether the scientific contract extends to real new public hydrology records with physical-rate integration, exact units and explicit abstention on gaps.
transfer.lookup_scope: USGS approved daily mean discharge, historical calendar days, one station independently selected for sensitivity to nonconstant flows. No operational flood or water management decision.
transfer.controls: Compare independent floating-point trapezoid where point samples apply and explicit summation for listed daily mean intervals; for interval means use mean times interval duration as the designated strongest conventional calculation. Record date basis and deny unapproved records, mis-stated units and gaps. Compare the same raw values via ordinary CSV/JSON extraction.
